name: AI World Summit 2025
description: The premier gathering of AI researchers, engineers, and founders. Covers LLMs, RAG, computer vision, ethics, and the business of AI.

name: WebTech Conference 2025
description: The largest web development and cloud-native conference in North America. React, TypeScript, serverless, DevOps, and the modern web stack.

name: ML Europe 2025
description: Europe's leading machine learning and data science conference. Cutting-edge research in deep learning, MLOps, and responsible AI.

name: NeurIPS 2025
description: One of the world's top academic ML conferences. Presents peer-reviewed research on deep learning theory, generative models, optimization, and AI safety.

name: CyberSec World 2026
description: Asia's largest cybersecurity conference. Covers zero trust, threat intelligence, AI-powered attacks and defences, secure cloud, and compliance.

name: Web3 & Blockchain Summit 2026
description: The Middle East's premier blockchain and decentralised technology event. DeFi, smart contracts, zero-knowledge proofs, DAOs, and tokenomics.

name: KubeCon Europe 2026
description: The flagship European conference for Kubernetes and cloud-native computing. Platform engineering, service mesh, observability, GitOps, and eBPF.

name: PyCon US 2026
description: The largest annual gathering of Python developers. Language updates, packaging, async patterns, data science, and the CPython internals.

name: Data & AI Summit 2026
description: The world's largest open-source data and AI conference. Apache Spark, Delta Lake, streaming, feature stores, data mesh, and lakehouse architecture.

name: React Summit 2026
description: Europe's biggest React conference. React 20, React Native, state management, performance, design systems, accessibility, and AI-powered UIs.

name: ICML 2026
description: The International Conference on Machine Learning. Top-tier research in optimization, generative models, learning theory, fairness, and foundation models.

name: Open Source Summit 2026
description: The Linux Foundation's flagship open source event. Linux kernel, open source AI, community governance, security, sustainability, and WebAssembly.

name: HealthTech & AI 2026
description: AI transforming healthcare — medical imaging, drug discovery, clinical decision support, wearables, genomics, and FDA regulatory pathways for AI devices.

name: Quantum Tech Summit 2026
description: The leading European conference on quantum computing, quantum error correction, and quantum networking. Covers superconducting qubits, trapped ions, topological qubits, and the road to fault tolerance.

name: BioTech World 2026
description: The premier biotechnology conference spanning CRISPR gene editing, mRNA therapeutics, synthetic biology, AI-driven protein design, and the regulatory landscape for biologics.

name: Deep Learning Summit 2026
description: Cutting-edge deep learning research and applications. State space models, vision transformers, neural scaling laws, efficient inference, physics-informed networks, and geometric deep learning.

name: Computational Neuroscience 2026
description: Where neuroscience meets AI. Covers spiking neural networks, brain-computer interfaces, neural population dynamics, connectomics, and computational models of perception and memory.

name: Computational Chemistry 2026
description: Advances in computational chemistry and molecular simulation. ML interatomic potentials, neural network wavefunctions, free energy calculations, molecular dynamics, and automated reaction discovery.

name: ISMB 2026
description: Intelligent Systems for Molecular Biology — the flagship bioinformatics conference. Single-cell genomics, protein structure prediction, multi-omics integration, metagenomics, and spatial transcriptomics.

name: Physics Summit 2026
venue: CERN Globe of Science and Innovation
description: Frontiers of modern physics — gravitational wave astronomy, LHC particle physics, dark matter searches, JWST cosmology, machine learning for experiments, and the quest for nuclear fusion energy.

name: Cell & Gene Therapy 2026
description: The world's leading cell and gene therapy conference. CAR-T cells, AAV vectors, base editing, lentiviral gene correction, iPSC-derived therapies, and in-vivo CRISPR delivery strategies.

name: Deep Learning Conference 2026
description: Applied deep learning research and industry practice. Diffusion models, test-time compute, multi-agent LLM systems, world models for robotics, hallucination mitigation, and automated neural architecture search.

name: RECOMB 2026
description: Research in Computational Molecular Biology. Genome assembly algorithms, RNA structure prediction, comparative genomics, epigenomics, single-cell multi-omics, and protein language models.

name: Chemistry & Drug Design Summit 2026
description: AI-driven chemistry at the interface of drug design and materials science. Generative molecular models, retrosynthesis planning, ADMET prediction, battery materials, green chemistry, and self-driving labs.

name: Astrophysics Conference 2026
description: Latest discoveries in observational and theoretical astrophysics. Black hole imaging, exoplanet atmospheres from JWST, fast radio bursts, multimessenger astronomy, and ML for large sky surveys.

name: Synthetic Biology Conference 2026
description: Engineering biology from the ground up. Genetic circuit design, cell-free systems, directed evolution with ML, synthetic genomes, living therapeutics, and biosafety governance.

name: Society for Neuroscience 2026
description: The annual SfN meeting bringing together neuroscientists worldwide. Memory consolidation, optogenetics, AI for neurological drug discovery, large-scale neural recording, organoid intelligence, and brain atlases.

name: Medicinal Chemistry Conference 2026
description: Advances in small molecule drug discovery. Fragment-based design, covalent inhibitors, PROTACs, macrocycle therapeutics, phenotypic screening with AI, and multi-parameter optimisation for clinical candidates.

name: Materials Science Summit 2026
description: Frontiers of materials discovery and design. High-entropy alloys, perovskite solar cells, 2D materials, solid-state batteries, photonic metamaterials, and self-healing polymers guided by ML.

name: Genome Informatics 2026
description: Computational genomics at the frontier. Pangenome graphs, deep learning variant calling, gene regulatory network inference, epigenetic modifications from nanopore, and clinical rare disease genomics.
